personal.name: Mohammad Shariq Saifi
personal.title: SDET | Test Automation & Quality Engineering
personal.summary: Software Development Engineer in Test with four years of experience in web, API, and database testing. I build maintainable automation, investigate defects, and help teams make informed release decisions. Open to quality engineering opportunities across industries.

responsibilities: Automated 400+ regression scenarios, reducing repetitive manual testing effort by approximately 40%.
Designed and maintained automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, Playwright, and Pytest, with reusable components and Page Object Model.
Built REST API checks and validated backend data to test business rules beyond the user interface.
Integrated automated suites with Jenkins and GitHub Actions to provide repeatable feedback during development and release cycles.
Delivered testing for banking applications covering Corporate Actions, SWIFT payments, and ISO15022 / ISO20022 messaging.
Validated JSON and XML payloads with Postman, Python Requests, and Newman; used SQL and Oracle SQL Developer to check data integrity.
Used WireMock and Pact for service virtualization, API mocking, and contract testing.
Integrated Playwright MCP with GitHub Copilot to support writing, debugging, and maintaining UI tests.
Worked with delivery teams on defect triage, root cause analysis, UAT, and Agile release validation.

projects.name: Web Regression Automation
projects.description: Automated Corporate Actions workflows in a banking application, turning repetitive regression checks into reusable suites that support consistent release validation.
features: Translated business workflows into repeatable automated regression scenarios.
Organized tests with Page Object Model, data-driven, and keyword-driven patterns to simplify maintenance.
Connected regression suites to CI/CD pipelines for consistent execution and timely feedback.

projects.name: API & Data Validation
projects.description: Tested the path from financial messages and API payloads to stored transaction data, checking that each layer followed the expected business rules.
features: Validated SWIFT payment workflows and ISO15022 / ISO20022 message formats.
Checked REST API responses and JSON / XML schemas to identify payload and integration defects.
Used SQL and Oracle SQL Developer to verify transaction records and backend data integrity.
